title: Janus_Tachyon_Star_Riders_TimeTraveler_Bridge
purpose: Preserve the methodological continuity between the JANUS Riders on the Storm / Tahyon Traveler distributed-time experiments and the TACHYON STAR astronomical program. The transferable principle is preregistered observer placement: freeze the target coordinate, target time or cadence slot, offset pattern, thresholds and integrity witness before opening the target observation. Distributed-system timestamp anomalies are retained as their own result and are not imported as evidence for astrophysical retrocausality.

arrival_order_inversion.meaning: A later scheduler target can materialize in Git before an earlier scheduler target across a distributed pipeline.

mapping.T_target: sealed sky coordinate + sealed B exposure/time + sealed A/C offsets
mapping.integrity_witness: Git commit + manifest SHA-256 + immutable file hashes
mapping.observer_result: post-read A/B/C classification under frozen sensitivity and PSF gates

forbidden_post_read_actions: move the sky coordinate after seeing pixels
replace a failed source with a more attractive source
relax SNR or morphology thresholds after seeing pixels
discard negative or blocked trials because they do not fit the hypothesis

t1_pixel_blind_holdout.primary_rule: one metadata-selected A-B-C trial per source minimizing distance to the frozen training offsets

external_non_nuclear_corpora.data: FFI cadence is 200 s in Cycle 5+; selected target pixel products include 120 s and 20 s cadences; TESSCut can return pixel cutouts and sector coverage for a preselected coordinate.
external_non_nuclear_corpora.strength: continuous cadence makes isolated one-cadence motifs directly testable without selecting nuclear dates

external_non_nuclear_corpora.data: 30 s exposures, 47 square degree camera, science-image API, metadata API, difference images, catalogs, pointing history and moving-object search.
external_non_nuclear_corpora.strength: independent optical instrument with high angular resolution relative to TESS and explicit moving-object tooling

external_non_nuclear_corpora.data: public short-cadence target pixel time series at approximately one-minute cadence
external_non_nuclear_corpora.strength: large repeated pixel time series suitable for estimating how often a one-cadence A-absent/B-present/C-absent morphology occurs under a stable space instrument

future_test_family.name: JANUS TACHYON STAR PREPOINTED OBSERVER SERIES
future_test_family.primary_question: Does a real sky-origin isolated-transient class survive preregistered coordinate/time selection, local sensitivity checks, moving-object tests, detector controls and independent-instrument witnesses?
timing_modes: TRAINED_ASYMMETRIC: A=-232.5827 s, B=0, C=+432.2595 s when compatible with cadence
CADENCE_NATIVE: nearest pre-B and post-B valid cadences for instruments whose sampling cannot reproduce the exact LUCI offsets
SYMMETRIC_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: matched +/-k cadence windows preregistered independently of the training motif
success_ladder: L0: isolated candidate in one detector
L1: candidate survives local PSF/sensitivity/artifact controls
L2: simultaneous independent detector or independent observatory supports sky origin
L3: replicated event class across preregistered holdout coordinates/times
L4: mundane moving-object/atmospheric/instrumental explanations strongly constrained
L5: only after lower levels pass may exotic propagation models be compared quantitatively
